Dublin Latest News

  1. Stay up to date

  1. Community Meetings Scheduled for Dublin Fallon 580 Residential Projects

    The City of Dublin is hosting two community meetings to share information about the proposed Dublin Fallon 580 Residential projects. Read on...

  2. Senior Info Fair: One Stop for Many Community Resources

    The community is invited to attend the annual Senior Info Fair, a one-stop event connecting older adults, caregivers, and families with valuable resources. It's on Saturday, October 3, from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at the Dublin Senior Center. Read on...

  3. Summary of Actions Taken by Dublin City Council on Tuesday, September 15

    At its meeting held on Tuesday, September 15th, the Dublin City Council took a number of actions. Read on...

  4. Community Meetings Set for Proposed Schaefer Ranch Development

    The City of Dublin is hosting two Community Meetings to provide Dublin residents with information about the proposed Schaefer Ranch Unit 3 and Unit 1, Lot 70 project. Read on...

  5. Celebrate Fall Traditions with Dublin’s 2026 Home Decorating Contest

    The 2026 Fall Home Decorating Contest invites Dublin residents to showcase creative displays inspired by fall traditions around the world. Read on...

  6. Registration Is Now Open for the 2026 Dublin Trail Challenge!

    The Dublin Trail Challenge returns this fall. Join us September 7 through October 11, 2026, and challenge yourself to get active, explore the community, and complete your miles at your own pace. Read on...

  7. Celebrate National Senior Center Month at the Dublin Senior Center

    September is National Senior Center Month, and the Dublin Senior Center is pleased to celebrate throughout the month with a variety of special events and activities. Read on...

  8. Back to School: Know the Rules for E-Bikes, E-Scooters & Other Micro-Mobility Devices

    As students head back to school, the City of Dublin and Dublin Police Services want to remind riders and families about the rules for e-bikes, e-scooters, and other micro-mobility devices. Read on...

  9. Deadline Extended to Apply for the Position of Dublin Poet Laureate

    The City of Dublin is seeking applicants for the position of Poet Laureate, who serves as a public advocate for the appreciation and advancement of literary arts in Dublin. The application deadline has been extended to Friday, September 25, at 5:00 p.m. Read on...

  10. Night Market Brings Food, Music, and Vendors to St. Pat's Row Monthly Through November

    The City of Dublin invites the community to experience the return of the Night Market at St. Pat's Row beginning August 21. Read on...

  11. Tassajara Road Improvements Underway, Expected to Run Through November

    Drivers should prepare for roadwork delays on Tassajara Road through the end of November as part of a multi-phase effort to widen and rehabilitate the roadway. Read on...

  12. Zone 7 Flood Protection Maintenance Closes Sections of Dublin Trails This Summer

    Zone 7 Water Agency is conducting essential maintenance to the Tri-Valley flood protection system, and several Dublin trails will be impacted from now through mid-October. Read on...

  13. 2026 State of the City Address Streaming On Demand

    Mayor Sherry Hu delivered the 2026 State of the City address on Tuesday, February 24, 2026, at the Shannon Community Center. Tri-Valley Community Television (TV30) is now streaming the full address on demand. Read on...

  14. City of Dublin Announces 2025 Citizen, Young Citizen, and Organization of the Year

    The Volunteer Recognition Awards Event honored individuals and groups whose service and leadership significantly enhanced the quality of life for Dublin residents during the past year. Read on...

  15. ADU Accelerator Program to Help Address the Housing Crisis

    Cities across California are amping up efforts to encourage the production of ADUs to help address the housing crisis. The new ADU Accelerator Program, piloted by State Senator Steve Glazer, includes the City of Dublin and 14 other East Bay cities. Read on...
